'''Hut Eight Bravo''' was the name of one of the [[Pols Anaxes]] [[Republic Detention Center]]'s [[Prison/Legends|prison]] wings. Around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Hut Eight Bravo housed the imprisoned [[Ruusaan Skirata]], who was later rescued by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] [[Bardan Jusik]], [[Spar]], [[Sull]], and [[Fi Skirata]].<ref name="Order 66" />
